statistics_method.unit_of_analysis: One run; no pooling of trajectory samples across runs
statistics_method.mean_std: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1)
statistics_method.quantiles: Median and linear interpolation at (N-1)*p for quartiles; IQR=Q3-Q1
statistics_method.bootstrap: Percentile 95% CI for the mean of run-level metric; 20,000 resamples of the ten run indices with replacement
statistics_method.bootstrap_seed_per_metric: base + metric index in report order
statistics_method.missing_values: All ten values retained, including null for unmeasurable failed runs. Summaries are conditional on available values, including any measured values from failures. Nulls are not imputed; empty bootstrap samples excluded and counted. Success/coverage reported over all ten runs.
statistics_method.success_interval: Wilson binomial 95% interval, not a degenerate all-success bootstrap interval

observability_notes: 1022 bag scans is input, and observed_scan_topic_messages is the independent monitor count, not SLAM callback entries.
Graph nodes and /pose-correlated graph insertions are not processed-scan counters.
TF rejection and queue-full quantities are observed log-line counts; TF MessageFilter logs are throttled at 2500 ms and exact rejection/skip counts are unavailable.
ATE/yaw/RPE errors are conditional on reported coverage and use the unchanged frozen SE(2), exact timestamp association and 1 m RPE methodology.
Bootstrap intervals quantify run-to-run variability for this fixed bag/procedure, not generalization to other routes or worlds.

cohort_adjudication.replacement_policy: Exactly one user-authorized replacement; no automatic retries.
cohort_adjudication.invalidity_reason: Confirmed concurrent external rosbag playback; user adjudicated original run_010 invalid. Direct TF receipt was not captured, as documented in forensic evidence.
cohort_adjudication.original_outputs: Preserved byte-for-byte, including original run success fields and superseded aggregate reports.
